How do I use it properly the very first time?
To wear your Classic Huggie Earrings for the first time, simply hold the earring and gently pull the curved post open—the hinge sits at the bottom of the hoop.
Insert the post through your piercing, then push the two sides together until you feel and hear a gentle click. That secure snap hinge closure means your huggies are locked in and ready for 24/7 wear.
